summary: The Mamba Venture Program (MVP) is a venture-building program in Singapore that helps working professionals, SME owners and aspiring founders turn industry insight into a working product: validate the problem, build the MVP and test demand. It runs as a 1-month sprint (S$2,500) or a 3-month venture build (S$5,999). No equity is taken to join. It is run by Mamba Partners and Cybrdeck, with SG Innovation as ecosystem partner.
